title: template.update
description: Update existing templates. The templateid property must be defined for each template, all other properties are optional; only given properties are updated.

name.description: Visible name of the template. Default: host property value.

uuid.description: Universal unique identifier, used for linking imported templates to already existing ones. Auto-generated, if not given.

groups.description: Host groups to replace the current host groups the templates belong to. The host groups must have the groupid property defined.

tags.description: Template tags to replace the current template tags.

macros.description: User macros to replace the current user macros on the given templates.

hostmacroid.description: (readonly) ID of the host macro. Include to update an existing macro in place.

type.description: Type of macro. Possible values: 0 - (default) Text macro; 1 - Secret macro; 2 - Vault secret.

templates.description: Templates to replace the currently linked templates. Templates that are not passed are only unlinked. The templates must have the templateid property defined.

templates_clear.description: Templates to unlink and clear from the given templates. The templates must have the templateid property defined.
